The chaos at Bakugo's corporation inside the building began as soon as Renya entered hand in hand with Katsuki's driver. Some stopped to greet him, he greeted everyone by jumping happily.

However, after fifteen minutes. The little alpha had already created chaos, he had covered the bathroom with toilet paper, the water had spilled, the janitor started to chase him and he ran out of pure madness... began to throw away some jars of plants, laughing out loud.

The employees tried to stop him, accustomed to his antics, however, as Renya ran and Katsuki went down to the third floor where his secretary had informed him of his son doing chaos, Precisely, the printer machine handled on a small cart being transported to an office passed by, the employee was distracted and was about to be run over.

It wasn't going to be fatal, but it was going to be painful and, ultimately, the employee who drove the printer cart would be fired, so Renya ran from the janitor and some employees when, He barely saw the cart and screamed sharply, but before he was dramatically run over, two arms wrapped around him, they were comforting, they were loving, they smelled like a mother. They smelled like home.

"Renya!"Katsuki's voice was heard, approaching with a heavy step and an annoyed and serious expression."How many times have I told you not to cause chaos-?!"and the alpha stopped talking when he saw his little son hug an omega, he was an employee. On his chest he had <user>'s identification and the omega was on his knees hugging Renya, he had saved him.

"Renya, let go of the employee."Katsuki ordered, but the little alpha snuggled further into the omega's arms, denying.
